summary: PickPath auto-picker prefers Fleet over Hermes for ClassOwnerAPI when Fleet can fully authenticate and dispatch (usable token + key + binary); Hermes is fallback when Fleet incomplete or explicit --via=hermes.
reason: Fleet handles all signed commands reliably from anywhere. Auto-pick must check full dispatch readiness: (1) token is usable (valid or has refresh token), (2) signing key exists, (3) tesla-control binary on PATH. Expired/unrefreshable token falls back to Hermes instead of selecting Fleet and failing auth. Explicit --via=fleet always tries Fleet and lets dispatch surface specific errors.
validated_outcome: Valid-token+key+binary -> Fleet; expired-unrefreshable-token+hermesRunning -> Hermes fallback; --via=fleet always tries Fleet
